status: PREREGISTERED_BEFORE_FITTING — everything below is frozen as of this record; changes require a successor record
authority: owner instruction 2026-08-12: 'if model needs to be built - BUILD the model to the highest build quality available - create a high level WNBA model and fulfill all data requirements'
lineage_and_lessons: This build applies every practice the program has accumulated: preregister-then-fit (MLV2); official-plus-one finality and the season-aware crosswalk (8/11 acquisition); binaries unscaled (external v0.3 incident); league scoring-level term for totals (v0.4 audit M2); direct-vs-margin coherence gate AT REGISTRATION independent of any simulator (v0.4 audit C2/M1); per-target validation status on the emitted row (M4); feature-state stamp (M5); date-block bootstrap + Holm on every claim (8/10 corrections); walk-forward expanding split with fold-local standardization and inner-split penalty selection.

data.sources: staged bytes only (data/wnba/source/staging/**), 2017-2026, both families, hashes in the staging manifest + extension
data.labels: OFFICIAL-PLUS-ONE: a game enters the training/evaluation set only when the WNBA_OFFICIAL team-grain row and the ESPN team_box row agree on date + both teams + both scores under the season-aware crosswalk (Phoenix swap honoured; 11 exhibition codes excluded)
data.features_source: WNBA_OFFICIAL team-grain rows only (measure_type IS NULL), strictly before the game date
data.known_gap: official 2026 rows end 2026-07-22; ESPN-only finals after that are excluded from labels AND features per the finality rule. Every emitted forecast carries feature_state_as_of.

features_frozen_7: net_rtg_edge : season-to-date (points per possession scored minus allowed), home minus away, shrunk toward 0 by w = g/(g+10); possessions = FGA - OREB + TOV + 0.44*FTA
efg_edge    : season-to-date effective FG% (FGM + 0.5*FG3M)/FGA, home minus away
tov_edge    : season-to-date TOV per possession, AWAY minus HOME (positive = home better)
orb_edge    : season-to-date OREB rate proxy OREB/(FGA-FGM), home minus away
ftr_edge    : season-to-date FTA/FGA, home minus away
rest_edge   : days since last game (capped 5, first game = 5), home minus away — CONTINUOUS
b2b_edge    : back-to-back indicator (rest == 1), home minus away, values {-1,0,1} — BINARY-LIKE, NEVER STANDARDIZED

targets.home_win: ridge logistic on the 7 features; fold-local standardization of the 6 continuous features only; l2 from {0.1,1,10,100} on an inner 80/20 split of the training window
targets.home_margin: ridge OLS, same features, same discipline
targets.total: ridge OLS on [league_mean_total_as_of (expanding, within-era), pace_sum_dev, net_rtg_sum] — the league level term is the M2 lesson and is the FIRST feature, not an afterthought

split: expanding walk-forward by game date across 2017-2026; burn_in 300 labelled games; a game is eligible only when both teams have >= 5 prior games that season
eligibility_note_2020: the 2020 bubble season has no true home court; rows are kept (the intercept and rest features absorb what they can) and this is recorded as a known limitation, not silently dropped

comparisons_holm_family: home_win vs expanding base-rate baseline (paired Brier, game-date block bootstrap, 4000 reps, seed 11)
home_margin vs expanding training-mean baseline (paired MAE, same bootstrap)
total vs expanding training-mean baseline (paired MAE, same bootstrap)
emission_gates_ALL_required_for_the_win_: p_holm < 0.05 with the CI on the improving side
calibration slope in [0.85, 1.15] and intercept in [-0.15, 0.15]
inference_and_gates.per_target_validation_status: each target is stamped VALIDATED_VS_BASELINE or NOT_BETTER_THAN_BASELINE on every emitted row; a failed margin/total target is still emitted with its failure visible (M4), but a failed WIN target blocks the card entirely
inference_and_gates.registration_coherence_gate: no row may be registered with |p_home - Phi(margin_pred / 13.97)| > 0.05; 13.97 is the empirical margin sd measured from the staged bytes on 8/11. This gate runs at registration, needs no simulator, and is the gate whose absence produced the external PHX@LA incident.
inference_and_gates.on_fail: NO_CARD. The record states which gate failed and the model stays shadow-diagnostic. No retuning without a successor prereg.

governance.identity: new model_id, registered in harness/model_registry.py; V13/V14 identities untouched
governance.firewall: unchanged — no WNBA number reaches the MLB gate, forecasts, ledger or policy gate. WNBA forecasts live in data/wnba/forecasts/, hash-bound, OUTSIDE the MLB chain so MLB gate counts cannot be polluted
governance.wnba_market_module: unchanged — the market layer stays structurally model-free; model output lives in separate artifacts
governance.authority_of_output: SHADOW DIAGNOSTIC. Paper only. Promotion requires a separate prospective gate. Wagers 0/100 NO_PROMOTE regardless of every result above.
